items.title_zh: AI 需求旺盛，全球最大芯片制造商台积电销售额激增 45%
items.summary_zh: 台积电为英伟达、谷歌等科技巨头代工芯片，其财务数据因而被广泛视为 AI 半导体需求的风向标。

items.title: The People's Bank of China issues its 15th Five Year Plan for reform and development
items.summary: To implement the guiding principles of the 20th Party Congress and its plenary sessions and the decisions of the Central Financial Work Conference, and in line with the Outline of the 15th Five Year Plan for National Economic and Social Development, the People's Bank of China recently issued the PBoC 15th Five Year Plan for Reform and Development together with 9 supporting action plans for related sub-sectors.
items.title_zh: 中国人民银行印发《中国人民银行“十五五”改革发展规划》
items.summary_zh: 为全面贯彻党的二十大和二十届历次全会精神，深入落实中央金融工作会议决策部署，根据《中华人民共和国国民经济和社会发展第十五个五年规划纲要》有关要求，近日，中国人民银行印发《中国人民银行“十五五”改革发展规划》（以下简称《规划》），并配套制定出台了9份相关细分领域的行动方案

items.title: Storms from Typhoon Dolphin soak China's east, ground nearly 950 Shanghai flights
items.summary: Torrential rain and storms in Typhoon Dolphin's wake inundated several provinces in China's east, drenching the coastal region and flooding streets in Shanghai.
items.title_zh: 台风“白海豚”带来的风雨浸淹中国东部，上海近 950 架次航班停飞
items.summary_zh: 台风“白海豚”过境后的暴雨与风暴淹没了中国东部多个省份，沿海地区普遍受浸，上海多条街道积水。

items.title: Meta faces a 1.4 trillion dollar damages claim
items.summary: After two prior convictions and nearly 1 billion dollars in damages, Meta will be back in the defendant's seat in federal court this week.
items.title_zh: Meta被索赔1.4万亿美元
items.summary_zh: 继已有两次定罪和近10亿美元赔偿后，美国元宇宙平台公司（Meta）本周将再次站上联邦法庭被告席

items.title: Meta launches a small AI model that runs on a PC with a single graphics card
items.summary: As the social media giant released a new open weight model on Monday, Meta chief executive Mark Zuckerberg called on the United States to lower barriers to entry for open source AI models.
items.title_zh: Meta推出小型AI模型，仅需一块显卡即可在PC上运行
items.summary_zh: 随着这家社交媒体巨头于周一发布一款新的开放权重模型，Meta首席执行官马克·扎克伯格 (Mark Zuckerberg) 呼吁美国降低对开源AI模型的准入门槛

items.title: Doubao starts taking a cut: hotel bookings through the Doubao channel move to a separate rate totalling 12%
items.summary: Hotel orders completed via Douyin Laike after being referred from the Doubao entry point will from today be charged a separate rate of 11.4% in software service fees plus 0.6% in payment processing, for a combined rate of about 12%.
items.title_zh: 豆包开始“抽佣”：豆包渠道的酒店订单开始执行独立费率，综合扣费12%
items.summary_zh: 有消息称，从今日起，通过豆包入口跳转抖音来客成交的酒店订单，将执行独立费率：11.4%的软件服务费加0.6%的支付手续费，综合费率约12%

items.title: Alibaba Cloud plans to more than triple its global data centre capacity
items.summary: Alibaba Cloud is converting its accumulated technology into quantifiable commercial advantage.
items.title_zh: 阿里云计划将全球数据中心产能提升两倍以上
items.summary_zh: 阿里云正将技术积累转化为可量化的商业优势

items.title: More runoff, fewer hikes: how Warsh is reshaping market rate expectations
items.summary: Since taking office as Fed chair, Warsh has run external communication on a say less, do more philosophy, reducing policy interference with markets.
items.title_zh: 更多缩表、更少加息：沃什如何重塑市场加息预期？
items.summary_zh: 自沃什就任美联储主席以来，其对美联储对外沟通框架秉持少说多做理念，减少对市场的政策干预

items.title: South Korea's presidential office to set up a 5 trillion won fund focused on promising semiconductor materials, components and equipment
items.summary: South Korea's presidential office said it will establish a new fund of up to 5 trillion won focused on investment in promising semiconductor materials, components and equipment.
items.title_zh: 韩国总统办公室：将设立规模达5万亿韩元的新基金，重点投资于有前景的半导体材料、零部件和设备领域
items.summary_zh: 韩国总统办公室：将设立规模达5万亿韩元的新基金，重点投资于有前景的半导体材料、零部件和设备领域

items.title: J&T Express fined 70,000 yuan for failing to meet unified security management obligations, per the State Post Bureau
items.summary: J&T Express Co., Ltd. was fined 70,000 yuan for failing to carry out its unified security management responsibilities as required.
items.title_zh: 极兔速递有限公司因未按规定履行安全保障统一管理责任被处以罚款70000元。（国家邮政局网站）
items.summary_zh: 极兔速递有限公司因未按规定履行安全保障统一管理责任被处以罚款70000元

items.title: The inflection point has arrived: Goldman Sachs says AI is rewriting SaaS results and the winners and losers are emerging
items.summary: The wave of AI agents is turning structural divergence in the software industry from expectation into reality.
items.title_zh: 拐点已至！高盛：AI开始改写SaaS业绩，赢家与输家名单浮现
items.summary_zh: AI智能体浪潮正在将软件行业的结构性分化从预期变为现实

items.title: Nearly 70 tech companies backed in seven years: China Life Equity keeps adding to hard technology
items.summary: Just after the seventh anniversary of the STAR Market, regulators continue to encourage long term capital into the market, and insurance money as archetypal patient capital is seen as an important companion for hard technology companies through the cycle; at this juncture China Life Equity has published its seven year investment record on the STAR Market.
items.title_zh: 七年布局近70家科创企业，国寿股权继续加码硬科技
items.summary_zh: 科创板开市七周年刚过，监管层持续推动中长期资金入市，保险资金作为典型的“长钱”被寄予厚望，被视为硬科技企业穿越周期的重要陪伴者； 在这一节点，国寿股权交出了其深耕科创板的七年投资账本

items.title: Alibaba Cloud plans to more than triple its global data centre capacity
items.summary: Alibaba Cloud has cut the delivery time for large AIDC data centres to 100 days on the back of a fully modular design architecture.
items.title_zh: 阿里云计划将全球数据中心产能提升两倍以上
items.summary_zh: 记者获悉，基于全模块化设计架构，阿里云已将大型AIDC数据中心的交付工期缩短至100天

items.title: Billions in market value missed? DJI once held a stake in Unitree but exited in 2019, and declines to comment
items.summary: Unitree formally opened online and offline subscription for its share offering today.

items.summary_zh: 今日，宇树科技正式启动网上网下申购

items.title: Australian rare earth miner surges after U.S. Department of War investment
items.summary: The Trump administration has backed plans to build an Australian scandium mine as part of a push to challenge China’s critical-minerals dominance.
items.title_zh: 获美国战争部投资后，澳大利亚稀土矿商股价大涨
items.summary_zh: 特朗普政府已支持在澳大利亚建设一座钪矿的计划，作为挑战中国关键矿产主导地位的举措之一。

items.title: US consumption may be heading for an epic downturn that AI cannot rescue
items.summary: Noted Canadian economist David Rosenberg says US consumers are borrowing from the future, with the savings rate sliding while credit card debt keeps climbing.
items.title_zh: 美国消费可能迎来“史诗级衰退”，AI根本救不了
items.summary_zh: 加拿大知名经济学家David Rosenberg表示，美国消费者正在透支未来，储蓄率持续下滑，信用卡债务却不断攀升
